mathlib.qualification: Fresh compilation required; this lock alone is not proof evidence.

command: lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true proofs/ContinuumProperties.lean (from pinned mathlib workspace)

claims.claim: Adding one real translation to all four vertices leaves the tetrahedral edge matrix unchanged.
claims.assumptions: Four real three-dimensional vertex vectors; the same translation acts on each vertex. A meaningful physical deformation gradient additionally requires a nondegenerate reference tetrahedron.
claims.limitations: No floating-point equivalence, boundary triangulation, inversion detection, equilibrium or biological claim is established.
claims.implementation: web/continuum-properties.mjs: measureTetrahedron and boundaryMeasurements; numerical geometry and translation are checked separately.

claims.claim: The determinant of a product of real 3 by 3 matrices is the product of their determinants.
claims.assumptions: Real square matrices; this supports F=Ds*inverse(Dm) with separately assumed invertible reference geometry.
claims.limitations: Does not certify JavaScript matrix multiplication/inversion, mesh orientation or boundary measurements.
claims.implementation: web/continuum-properties.mjs: multiply3 and measured deformation gradient; separate nontrivial matrix and geometric tests.

claims.claim: The real axial/lateral diagonal deformation diag(lambda,b,b) has determinant lambda × b × b.
claims.assumptions: Real stretches; physical use additionally requires lambda>0 and b>0. Unit determinant follows whenever the stated product equals one.
claims.limitations: A kinematic identity; no force equilibrium, finite-bulk incompressibility, material response or biological correctness follows.
claims.implementation: web/continuum-properties.mjs: isochoricState; independent oriented boundary and area-times-length measurements.

claims.claim: For real lambda>0, b=1/sqrt(lambda) is positive and diag(lambda,b,b) has unit determinant.
claims.assumptions: Positive real axial stretch and the exact real square-root construction.
claims.limitations: Does not prove binary64 sqrt/division or measured browser volume is exact, and does not establish a passive or active equilibrium.
claims.implementation: web/continuum-properties.mjs: the actual isochoric toggle; floating-point boundary-volume error is reported.

claims.claim: For positive real uniform scale, Lab 5’s declared isochoric energy density is exactly zero.
claims.assumptions: Positive real s; declared J=s³, I₁=3s² and exact real power.
claims.limitations: Does not prove zero volume energy, binary64 power correctness, constitutive calibration or full displacement stability.
claims.implementation: web/compression.mjs with unchanged web/tissue.mjs; independent geometric volume, volume-variable traction equation and energy derivatives checked numerically.

claims.claim: The actual simple-shear matrix has unit determinant, shape energy μγ²/2 and zero quadratic volume energy.
claims.assumptions: Exact real gamma, mu and bulk; physical use requires mu>0 and bulk≥0.
claims.limitations: No stress derivative, browser arithmetic, mesh equilibrium or biological validation is proved.
claims.implementation: web/compression.mjs with unchanged web/tissue.mjs; independent geometric volume, volume-variable traction equation and energy derivatives checked numerically.

claims.claim: For the declared diagonal split Cauchy law, mean compressive stress equals K(1−J).
claims.assumptions: Exact real identity for the displayed components; physical use requires positive t and h, mu>0 and K≥0.
claims.limitations: Does not certify the Piola-to-Cauchy code, stress derivatives or a pressure discretization.
claims.implementation: web/compression.mjs with unchanged web/tissue.mjs; independent geometric volume, volume-variable traction equation and energy derivatives checked numerically.

claims.claim: At zero lateral traction, plate compressive pressure equals three times K(1−J).
claims.assumptions: Declared diagonal Cauchy law and zero lateral Cauchy stress; physical use requires positive stretches and positive current area.
claims.limitations: Conditional algebra only; no existence, uniqueness, stability or numerical root acceptance is proved.
claims.implementation: web/compression.mjs with unchanged web/tissue.mjs; independent geometric volume, volume-variable traction equation and energy derivatives checked numerically.
